# traits: Species Trait Data from Around the Web

# traits

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/ropensci/traits/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ropensci/traits/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![rstudio mirror
downloads](https://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/traits)](https://github.com/r-hub/cranlogs.app)
[![cran
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/traits)](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=traits)
[![DOI](https://zenodo.org/badge/DOI/10.5281/zenodo.11224037.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11224037)

R client for various sources of species trait data.

Docs: <https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/>

What is a trait? A “trait” for the purposes of this package is broadly
defined as an aspect of a species that can be described or measured,
such as physical traits (size, length, height, color), behavioral traits
(running speed, etc.), and even variables that make up the niche of the
species (e.g., habitat).

Included in `traits` with the associated function prefix or function
name:

| Source | Function prefix | Link |
|:---|:---|:---|
| BETYdb | `betydb_` | <https://www.betydb.org/> |
| NCBI | `ncbi_` | <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/> |
| Encyclopedia of Life | `traitbank_` | <https://github.com/EOL/publishing/blob/master/doc/api.md> |
| Birdlife International | `birdlife_` | <https://www.birdlife.org/> |
| LEDA Traitbase | `leda_` |  |
| Zanne et al. plant dataset | `tr_zanne` |  |
| Amniote life history dataset | `tr_ernest` |  |

Talk to us on the issues page
(<https://github.com/ropensci/traits/issues>) if you know of a source of
traits data with an API, and we’ll see about including it.

## Installation

CRAN

``` r

install.packages("traits")
```

R-Universe (alternative)

``` r

install.packages(
  "traits",
  repos = c("https://ropensci.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org")
)
```

Development version from GitHub

``` r

remotes::install_github("ropensci/traits")
```

``` r

library("traits")
library("dplyr")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`betydb_record()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  [`betydb_trait()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  [`betydb_specie()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  [`betydb_citation()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  [`betydb_site()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  [`betydb_experiment()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb.md)
  : Search for traits from BETYdb
- [`betydb_query()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb_query.md)
  [`betydb_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/betydb_query.md)
  : Query a BETY table
- [`birdlife_habitat()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/birdlife_habitat.md)
  : Get bird habitat information from BirdLife/IUCN
- [`birdlife_threats()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/birdlife_threats.md)
  : Get bird threat information from BirdLife/IUCN
- [`leda()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/leda.md) :
  Access LEDA trait data
- [`ncbi_byid()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/ncbi_byid.md)
  : Retrieve gene sequences from NCBI by accession number.
- [`ncbi_byname()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/ncbi_byname.md)
  : Retrieve gene sequences from NCBI by taxon name and gene names.
- [`ncbi_searcher()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/ncbi_searcher.md)
  : Search for gene sequences available for taxa from NCBI.
- [`plantatt`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/plantatt.md) :
  PLANTATT plant traits dataset
- [`taxa_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/taxa_search.md)
  : Search for traits by taxa names
- [`tr_ernest()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/tr_ernest.md)
  : Amniote life history dataset
- [`tr_zanne()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/tr_zanne.md)
  : Zanne et al. plant dataset
- [`traitbank()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/traitbank.md)
  : Search for traits from EOL's Traitbank
- [`traits-defunct`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/traits-defunct.md)
  : Defunct functions in traits
- [`traits_cache`](https://docs.ropensci.org/traits/reference/traits_cache.md)
  : Caching
